verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, not a hosted or cloud service, so choosing a storage region or data residency is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it offering any such capability; the pack covers only performance, overclocking, memory and storage-interface specs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
